decisions.reason: A Magento 2 shop template is close to the core agency hosting offer and cheap to maintain, so with a growing industry and available slack it stays above aspiration, though templates are easily phased out quietly.
The responsive website template supports the core CMS hosting business at low cost, so there is no performance shortfall that would trigger problemistic search, despite only a minor web presence.
Premium support directly reinforces the firm's key differentiator of expert agency-focused support and likely generates recurring revenue, so it meets aspiration levels.
The version management tool builds on the platform, reduces recurring operational work for agencies as the strategy intends, and has its own page, signalling commitment.
The data processing contract tool is distant from the core offer, but the GDPR-driven demand and the firm's slack from growth and hiring let it carry this uncertain product for now.
